title: 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE---: the C-wave law in Lean
text: The return in C at a change of stage of 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE--- is now proved in Lean (cwave, lean/CWaveLaw.lean) for items 1 to R, for any number of items, every phase and every width with Q at least 2 and P at least 3 digits. Every word becomes 0 or 2, every 11 and 01 moves 2 cells, and R gets top digit 1, gaining a digit when its own phase is 2 or 3. Item 0, the new event cell and narrower words are still open.
